evals.name: operate-go-service
evals.prompt: Review a Go service that hardcodes database host in code, writes logs to a local file, and keeps session state in memory.
evals.expected_output: A 12-factor review covering config in environment (III), stateless processes (VI), and logs to stdout (XI).
assertions: Moves all configuration to environment variables (Factor III).
Externalizes session state to Redis/DB to maintain stateless processes (Factor VI).
Redirects application logging to stdout as unbuffered event stream (Factor XI).

evals.name: stateless-process-boundary
evals.prompt: Design horizontal scaling for a Go API where multiple instances handle client requests behind a load balancer.
evals.expected_output: Ensuring zero local disk or in-memory dependency between requests so any server can handle any request.
assertions: Process shares nothing and stores persistent data in backing services (Factor VI).
Scaling is achieved by running multiple concurrent process instances (Factor VIII).
Instance restarts or terminations have zero impact on other requests.

evals.name: graceful-sigterm-shutdown
evals.prompt: Implement graceful process termination in Go to comply with Factor IX (Disposability).
evals.expected_output: Handling SIGTERM by stopping listener, allowing active requests to finish within timeout, and closing backing pools.
assertions: Traps SIGTERM and SIGINT signals cleanly.
Calls http.Server.Shutdown(ctx) with timeout to finish in-flight requests.
Closes database connections and release resources before process exit.
